notes.title: Update and Demo for Prequel
notes.notes:
Dear Owlish Gourmets,

the demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633510/Owl_Observatory/]Owl Observatory[/url], the prequel to Dinner with an Owl, is [b]out now![/b]
Experience a completely new adventure and dive deeper into the time-twisting mysteries of your owlish host.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2633510/Owl_Observatory/][h3]Try the demo and add the game to your wishlist![/h3][/url]

[previewyoutube=0rWDOQpACa0;full][previewyoutube=0rWDOQpACa0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]


In addition to developing Owl Observatory, [b]Dinner with an Owl[/b] also received some love!
The newly [b]updated version[/b] includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] Added context-sensitive mouse cursors
[*] Items no longer stick to the cursor after use
[*] Adjusted the hotspot for Declan
[*] No more flickering in certain animations of Mr. Webb
[*] Some minor fixes
[/list]

[h3][b]Let's have Dinner![/b][/h3]
